description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services in an affordable manner.
eligibility_criteria: Must not have any other bank account
application_steps: Visit nearest bank branch or Bank Mitra.
Fill up the account opening form.
Submit required KYC documents.
Apply online at pmjdy.gov.in

description: Health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
eligibility_criteria: Belong to poor and vulnerable families based on SECC 2011.
No age or family size limit.
application_steps: Visit nearest empanelled hospital.
Provide Aadhaar card to the Ayushman Mitra.
Verify identity via fingerprint or OTP.
Register at pmjay.gov.in

description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families.
eligibility_criteria: Must own cultivable land in their name.
application_steps: Visit official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Submit Aadhaar and Bank details.

description: Affordable housing for all with credit-linked subsidy scheme.
eligibility_criteria: Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Annual family income less than ₹18 Lakhs.
application_steps: Apply via official portal pmaymis.gov.in.
Submit subsidy request to your bank.

description: Small deposit scheme for the girl child as part of the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign.
eligibility_criteria: Parents or legal guardians of a girl child.
Girl child must be below 10 years of age.
application_steps: Visit any post office or authorized bank branch.
Submit SSY account opening form.
Visit indiapost.gov.in for details.

description: Financial assistance to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at class VIII.
eligibility_criteria: Students who scored 55% in class VII.
application_steps: Register at National Scholarship Portal scholarships.gov.in.
Submit school verified documents.

description: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month for unorganized sector workers.
application_steps: Apply via any nationalized bank.
Check details on npscra.nsdl.co.in.

description: Loans up to ₹10 Lakhs for non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
eligibility_criteria: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for a non-farm income generating activity.
application_steps: Apply directly at mudra.org.in or any participating bank.
Submit project report.

description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one woman borrower per bank branch.
application_steps: Apply online at standupmitra.in.
Visit the chosen bank branch.

description: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 for pregnant women and lactating mothers.
eligibility_criteria: Not in regular employment with Central/State Govt.
application_steps: Apply online via pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

Meter must be linked with Aadhaar.
application_steps: Visit the local electricity board office.
Submit Aadhaar and consumer number for linking.
Link online at power.andhrapradesh.gov.in

description: Annual scholarship of ₹10,000 for top 1000 students passing class 10th in Andhra Pradesh board.
eligibility_criteria: Passed class 10th from Andhra Pradesh Board.
application_steps: Schools automatically nominate top students.
Submit bank details to the school principal.
Check status online at education.andhrapradesh.gov.in

description: Free laptops provided to meritorious students pursuing higher education.
eligibility_criteria: Admitted to a recognized college/university in the state.
application_steps: Collect application form from the college administration.
Submit form with admission receipt.
Register online at highered.andhrapradesh.gov.in

description: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 for destitute senior citizens in Andhra Pradesh.
application_steps: Submit application physically at the District Social Welfare Office.
Track application online at pension.andhrapradesh.gov.in

description: Subsidy on purchase of agricultural equipment and machinery for farmers in Bihar.
application_steps: Visit the local Agriculture Office for offline submission.
Submit equipment quotation.

description: Crop insurance covering pre-sowing to post-harvest losses.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers in Bihar growing notified crops.
application_steps: Visit nearest bank branch with land details.
Pay the premium amount before the cutoff date.

description: Seed funding up to ₹5 Lakhs for youth-led tech startups in Bihar.
eligibility_criteria: Founder must be domiciled in Bihar.
application_steps: Submit physical business plan to the District Industries Centre (DIC).
Attend the screening interview.
Apply online at startup.bihar.gov.in

description: Free medical treatment up to ₹3 Lakhs for BPL families in state hospitals.
application_steps: Show BPL card at any Govt Hospital in bihar to get registered.
Collect the health card from the hospital desk.
Apply online at health.bihar.gov.in

description: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month for women heads of families.
application_steps: Collect application form from the Gram Panchayat.
Submit filled form along with Aadhaar and bank details.
Apply online at women.bihar.gov.in

description: Financial aid of ₹1.2 Lakhs for building pucca houses in rural areas of Bihar.
eligibility_criteria: Does not own a concrete house.
application_steps: Apply in person at the Block Development Office (BDO).
Wait for the physical site inspection.
Apply online at housing.bihar.gov.in
